title: Rules Refactor, Phase 4: what waits for you
description: Everything from steps 16 to 19 that needs your hand or your call: 3 things to do, 2 calls, the project docs that can leave, and the memory cleanup.
intro: Steps 16 to 19 are built. This page holds only what Claude could not do or decide alone. Nothing here is urgent, and nothing is deleted or changed until you pick.
Every bigger call Claude made without you is in the Decisions log of the Autopilot doc, each with how to undo it.

sections.title: Yours to do
sections.sub: Only you can press these buttons.

cards.title: Save the 4 skill cards
rows: coach-gen-writer is in the first Phase 4 chat (11 Nov). The other 3 are in the chat of 11 to 15 Nov.
From 6,400 words to about 2,000. It loads a card from the rules table, lints every pass and runs the checkers once.
It now also does the work of fold-article-lessons. A new rule must pass your test set before you see it, and is stored only on your go.
Two lines each. Every new entry also keeps what the line answered, one line of context and the words the person owns.
Delete fold-article-lessons and write-book-from-material in Settings, if they are still there.

cards.title: Paste the new project instructions
rows: They open with "Coach Wibawa (Coach Gen), ICF-certified coach" and repeat style rules that now live in the rules table.
10 lines: who you are, your stance, the marks, where the material and the rules live, how a draft is checked, the brand guide, the guardrails, the handoffs.
Every chat in the project reads them first. A rule repeated there drifts from the table.
The 10 lines are in the Autopilot doc, under "Paste text for the project instructions". Paste them over the old ones in the project settings.

cards.title: Take the semicolon out of your account-level preferences
rows: One line says: "use period, comma, colon, semicolon, or parentheses instead".
You banned semicolons everywhere on 4 Nov. Claude cannot edit account-level memory from inside this project.
In any chat outside the project, say: update my preference, no semicolons either.
